GSEA.BH_family: all eligible Hallmarks within each model

random_matching: pooled endothelial detection deciles; size matched within bins, without replacement per program; original genes allowed
LOPO: refit primary and both major cohort models without held-out patient; original filterByExpr/TMM/voom/robust eBayes; refit fraction SD; fixed background/ligands
ECM_exclusion_interpretation: prespecified stromal/ECM marker sensitivity; genes can also have authentic endothelial expression; exclusion not proof of contamination
EMT_gate: primary NES>0 and BH<0.10, both major cohort NES>0; otherwise REFERENCE_ONLY
curves: up to two largest positive and two most negative primary NES with BH<0.10; if none use prespecified EMT with nonsignificant label
optional_spatial: at most first 3 Set B top20 ligands with t20 positive CellChat and not previously spatial-tested; best patient-median CC axis per ligand; coverage/expression audit only, no new full spatial inference
